violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils ( slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC started to break down slicer. Staff to be instructed on proper cleaning procedures. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Door sweep was not fully sealing gap in door. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Procedures provided for establishment. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/03/2025

Containers/covers were observed stored directly under a soap dispenser next to hand sink. Equipment/utensils to be stored in a manner to prevent contamination. Items relocated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/03/2025
